info.title: Bryan’s reference public website API
info.description: Independent public-site intake and publication contract. Studio initiates all integration requests. Submission credentials cannot poll, acknowledge, verify payment or publish galleries. This API is distinct from the legacy Studio Public V1 API. Gallery exchange is request-bound and independent of website sign-in. Manifest digests use UTF-8 JSON with recursively sorted object keys and preserved array order. Studio initiates synchronization; API receipt is distinct from Studio import or external completion.

IntegrationBearer.description: Dedicated secret of at least 32 characters; required scope is x-required-scope on each operation.

WorkDayCookie.name: aegis_workday_session
WorkDayCookie.description: 8-hour staff web session. Browser mutations require same Origin and X-CSRF-Token from /api/intake-session.

locationCode.description: Required for bookings: BK is Kings Plaza; BE is East Queen Street.

IntakeSubmission.description: Booking additionally requires clientEmail, sessionTypeId, catalogRevision, slotId, and locationCode. The slot must be published by Studio for that current catalog revision and is reserved atomically on submission. Studio-published price and deposit are copied into an immutable JMD minor-unit pricing snapshot. Paid or confirmation claims are rejected. Inquiry does not create a permanent Studio client.

galleryId.description: Equals the verified gallery request ID.
